title: Spellbook (production build)
description: The built site that GitHub Pages serves. It shows every SRD spell for the chosen edition, filters by the URL hash, opens a spell from a shared link, survives a junk link, never injects typed text as HTML, credits the SRD licence, and loads its assets from relative URLs so it works under /spellbook/.

clicking the Wizard class narrows the list
a search that matches nothing must say so, not render blank
markup in the search term stays text
unknown values in every hash field fall back to defaults
Object.prototype names in the hash are not valid editions or flags
